conversations.user_input: User: I have just been accepted into the Maths  major at HKUST. Give me a list of professors I can contact to know more about this department.
conversations.response:
Congratulations on your acceptance into the Maths major at HKUST! That's fantastic news! Here’s a list of professors you can reach out to for more information about the department:

1. **Mo Mu (穆默)**  
   - Post: Professor  
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7446; mamu@ust.hk  
   - [Profile](http://www.math.ust.hk/people/faculty/profile/mamu/)

2. **Yuan Yao (姚遠)**  
   - Post: Professor  
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7461; yuany@ust.hk  
   - [Profile](http://www.math.ust.hk/people/faculty/profile/yuany/)

3. **Yongchang Zhu (朱永昌)**  
   - Post: Professor  
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7447; mazhu@ust.hk  
   - [Profile](http://www.math.ust.hk/people/faculty/profile/mazhu/)

4. **Zhigang Bao (鮑志剛)**  
   - Post: Associate Professor  
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7416; mazgbao@ust.hk  
   - [Profile](http://www.math.ust.hk/people/faculty/profile/mazgbao/)

5. **Ivan Chi Ho Ip (葉智皓)**  
   - Post: Associate Professor  
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7431; ivanip@ust.hk  
   - [Profile](http://www.math.ust.hk/people/faculty/profile/ivanip/)

6. **Beifang Chen (陳北方)**  
   - Post: Professor  
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7449; mabfchen@ust.hk  
   - [Profile](http://www.math.ust.hk/people/faculty/profile/mabfchen/)

7. **Edmund Yik Man Chiang (蔣翼邁)**  
   - Post: Professor  
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7441; machiang@ust.hk  
   - [Profile](http://www.math.ust.hk/people/faculty/profile/machiang/)

8. **Jishan Hu (胡繼善)**  
   - Post: Professor  
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7434; majhu@ust.hk  
   - [Profile](http://www.math.ust.hk/people/faculty/profile/majhu/)

9. **Shing Yu Leung (梁承裕)**  
   - Post: Professor  
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7414; masyleung@ust.hk  
   - [Profile](http://www.math.ust.hk/~masyleung/)

10. **Guowu Meng (孟國武)**  
    - Post: Professor  
    - Contact: (852) 2358 7451; mameng@ust.hk  
    - [Profile](http://www.math.ust.hk/people/faculty/profile/mameng/)

Feel free to reach out to them with any questions you have about the program. Best of luck with your studies! 

(Source: https://facultyprofiles.hkust.edu.hk/profiles.php?profile=mo-mu-mamu)
